40021113.author: पदार्थः
40021113.content: जिते when conquered, महेन्द्रे Mahendra, अतिबले exceedingly powerful, रावणस्य of Ravana, सुतेन by the son, वै indeed, प्रजापतिं Prajapati, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, ययुः went, लङ्कां to Lanka, सुराः the gods, तदा then.

40021113.author: Translation
40021113.content: When the exceedingly powerful Mahendra was indeed conquered by Ravana's son, the gods then went to Lanka, making Prajapati their leader.

40021114.author: पदार्थः
40021114.content: तत्र there, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having approached, पुत्रभ्रातृभिः by sons and brothers, आवृतम् surrounded, अब्रवीत् spoke, गगने in the sky, तिष्ठन् standing, सामपूर्वं with gentle words first, प्रजापतिः Prajapati.

40021114.author: Translation
40021114.content: There, Prajapati, standing in the sky, approached Ravana who was surrounded by his sons and brothers, and spoke to him first with gentle words.

40021115.author: पदार्थः
40021115.content: वत्स dear son, रावण Ravana, तुष्टः अस्मि I am pleased, पुत्रस्य with the son, तव your, संयुगे in battle, अहो oh!, अस्य his, विक्रमौदार्यं valor and magnanimity, तव your, तुल्यः equal, अधिकः superior, अपि वा or even.

40021115.author: Translation
40021115.content: Prajapati said, "Dear son Ravana, I am pleased with your son's performance in battle; oh, his valor and magnanimity are equal to yours, or perhaps even superior!"

40021116.author: पदार्थः
40021116.content: जितं conquered, हि indeed, भवता by you, सर्वं all, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, स्वेन by your own, तेजसा prowess, कृता made, प्रतिज्ञा vow, सफला fruitful, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased, स्वसुतेन by your own son, वै indeed.

40021116.author: Translation
40021116.content: Indeed, all three worlds have been conquered by your own prowess, and your vow has been made fruitful; I am truly pleased by your own son.

40021117.author: पदार्थः
40021117.content: अयं this, च and, पुत्रो son, अतिबलः exceedingly strong, तव your, रावण O Ravana, वीर्यवान् valorous, जगतीन्द्रजित् Indrajit in the world, इति thus, एव indeed, परिख्यातः renowned, भविष्यति will be

40021117.author: Translation
40021117.content: This exceedingly strong and valorous son of yours, O Ravana, will indeed be renowned in the world as Indrajit.

40021118.author: पदार्थः
40021118.content: बलवान् powerful, दुर्जयः unconquerable, च and, एव indeed, भविष्यति will be, एव indeed, राक्षसः demon, यं whom, समाश्रित्य having relied upon, ते by you, राजन् O King, स्थापिताः placed, त्रिदशाः the gods, वशे under control

40021118.author: Translation
40021118.content: This demon will indeed be powerful and unconquerable, O King, and it is by relying on him that you have kept the gods under your control.

40021119.author: पदार्थः
40021119.content: तत् therefore, मुच्यतां let him be released, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, महेन्द्रः the great Indra, पाकशासनः the slayer of Paka, किञ्च and also, अस्य his, मोक्षणार्थाय for the sake of release, प्रयच्छन्तु let them give, दिवौकसः the dwellers of heaven

40021119.author: Translation
40021119.content: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, let the great Indra, the slayer of Paka, be released, and let the gods also offer something for his liberation.

40021120.author: पदार्थः
40021120.content: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, समितिञ्जयः conqueror in battle, अमरत्वम् immortality, अहं I, देव O god, वृणे choose, यदि if, एषः this one, मुच्यते is released

40021120.author: Translation
40021120.content: Then, the greatly effulgent Indrajit, the conqueror in battle, spoke, saying, "O god, I choose immortality if this one (Indra) is released."

40021121.author: पदार्थः
40021121.content: चतुष्पदां of quadrupeds, खेचराणां of sky-dwellers, अन्येषां of others, वा or, महौजसां of greatly powerful ones, वृक्षगुल्मक्षुपलतातृणोपलमहीभृताम् of trees, bushes, shrubs, creepers, grasses, stones, and mountains

40021121.author: Translation
40021121.content: This refers to various categories of beings and objects, including quadrupeds, sky-dwellers, other greatly powerful entities, and also trees, bushes, shrubs, creepers, grasses, stones, and mountains.

40021122.author: पदार्थः
40021122.content: सर्वे all, अपि even, जन्तवः living beings, अन्योन्यम् each other, भेतव्ये when there is fear, सति being, बिभ्यति fear, अतः therefore, अत्र here, लोके in the world, सर्वेषाम् for all, सर्वस्मात् from everything, च and, भवेत् may be, भयम् fear.

40021122.author: Translation
40021122.content: All living beings fear each other when there is cause for fear, and thus in this world, everyone may experience fear from everything.

40021123.author: पदार्थः
40021123.content: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, मेघनादम् to Meghanada, प्रजापतिः Prajapati (Brahma), न not, अस्ति is, सर्वामरत्वम् complete immortality, हि indeed, कस्यचित् for anyone, प्राणिनः living being, भुवि on earth, चतुष्पदः four-footed animals, पक्षिणः birds, च and, भूतानाम् of beings, वा or, महौजसाम् of great power.

40021123.author: Translation
40021123.content: Then the greatly effulgent Prajapati Brahma spoke to Meghanada, stating that complete immortality indeed does not exist for any living being on earth, be it four-footed animals, birds, or even beings of great power.

40021124.author: पदार्थः
40021124.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, पितामहेन by the grandfather (Brahma), उक्तम् spoken, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit (Meghanada), प्रभुणा by the lord, अव्ययम् imperishable (words/truth).

40021124.author: Translation
40021124.content: Having heard the imperishable words spoken by his grandfather, Lord Brahma, Indrajit (Meghanada then responded).

40021125.author: पदार्थः
40021125.content: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, सः he, तत्रस्थम् to him who was present there, मेघनादः Meghanada, महाबलः the mighty, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, वा or, भवेत् may there be, सिद्धिः success, शतक्रतुविमोक्षणे in releasing Shakra (Indra).

40021125.author: Translation
40021125.content: Then the mighty Meghanada spoke to Brahma, who was present there, saying, "Let it be heard, or may there be success in releasing Indra."

40021126.author: पदार्थः
40021126.content: मम my, इष्टम् desire, नित्यशः always, हर्व्यैः with oblations, मन्त्रैः with mantras, सम्पूज्य having worshipped, पावकम् the fire, सङ्ग्रामम् battle, अवतर्त्तुम् to enter, च and, शत्रुनिर्जयकाङ्क्षिणः desiring victory over enemies.

40021126.author: Translation
40021126.content: My desire is to always worship the fire with oblations and mantras, and then to enter battle, desiring victory over my enemies.

40021127.author: पदार्थः
40021127.content: अश्वयुक्तो horse-yoked, रथो chariot, मह्यम् for me, उत्तिष्ठेत् should rise, तु indeed, विभावसोः of the sun, तत्स्थस्य of one standing on it, अमरता immortality, स्यात् should be, मे for me, एष this, मे my, निश्चयो firm resolve, वरः best.

40021127.author: Translation
40021127.content: My best resolve is that a horse-yoked chariot of the sun should rise for me, and immortality should be granted to one standing on it.

40021128.author: पदार्थः
40021128.content: देव O god, तस्मिन् that, जप्यहोमे rite of muttered prayer and oblation, विभावसौ in the fire, अद्य now, असमाप्ते while unfinished, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, यदि युध्येयम् if I should fight, तदा then, मे my, विनाशनम् destruction, स्यात् would come to be.

40021128.author: Translation
40021128.content: O god, should I ever go to fight in battle while my fire-oblation rite remains unfinished, then in that case my destruction would surely follow.

40021129.author: पदार्थः
40021129.content: सर्वो everyone, हि indeed, तपसा by penance, देव O god, वृणोति obtains, अमरताम् immortality, पुमान् a man, विक्रमेण by valor, मया by me, तु but, एतत् this, अमरत्वम् immortality, प्रवर्तितम् established.

40021129.author: Translation
40021129.content: O god, while every man indeed obtains immortality through penance, I have established this immortality through my valor.

40021130.author: पदार्थः
40021130.content: एवम् thus, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, तम् to him, च and, आह said, वाक्यम् word, देवः god, पितामहः Brahma, मुक्तः released, च and, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajit, शक्रो Indra, गताः went, च and, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, सुराः gods.

40021130.author: Translation
40021130.content: And thus, the god Brahma said to him, 'So be it,' whereupon Indra was released by Indrajit, and the gods returned to heaven.

40021131.author: पदार्थः
40021131.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, दीनो distressed, भ्रष्टाम्बरद्युतिः one whose celestial radiance was lost, इन्द्रः Indra, चिन्तापरीतात्मा whose mind was overwhelmed by worry, ध्यानतत्परताम् to the state of being absorbed in thought, गतः attained.

40021131.author: Translation
40021131.content: O Rama, in the meantime, Indra, distressed and having lost his celestial radiance, became absorbed in thought, his mind overwhelmed by worry.

40021132.author: पदार्थः
40021132.content: तम् him, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथाभूतम् in such a state, प्राह said, देवः god, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, शतक्रतो O Shatakratu, किमु what indeed, पुरा formerly, करोति did, स्म (past tense marker), सुदुष्कृतम् a very evil deed.

40021132.author: Translation
40021132.content: Indeed, having seen him in such a state, the god Prajapati (Brahma) asked, 'O Shatakratu, what great evil deed did you commit formerly?'

40021133.author: पदार्थः
40021133.content: अमरेन्द्र O king of immortals, मया by me, बह्व्यः many, प्रजाः creatures, सृष्टाः were created, तथा thus, प्रभो O lord, एकवर्णाः of one color, समाभाषाः speaking the same language, एकरूपाः of one form, च and, सर्वशः in every respect.

40021133.author: Translation
40021133.content: O Lord Indra, I created many beings who were all of the same color, spoke the same language, and had the same form in every respect.

40021134.author: पदार्थः
40021134.content: तासां among them, न not, अस्ति there is, विशेषः distinction, हि indeed, दर्शने in appearance, लक्षणे in characteristics, अपि even, वा or, ततः then, अहम् I, एकाग्रमनाः with a concentrated mind, ताः those, प्रजाः creatures, परिचिन्तयम् pondered.

40021134.author: Translation
40021134.content: Indeed, there was no distinction among them in appearance or even in characteristics, so I pondered deeply about those creatures with a concentrated mind.

40021135.author: पदार्थः
40021135.content: सः that, अहम् I, तासां among them, विशेषार्थं for the sake of distinction, स्त्रियम् a woman, एकां one, विनिर्ममे created, यद्यत् whatever, प्रजानां of the creatures, प्रत्यङ्गं each limb, विशिष्टं excellent, तत् तत् that that, उद्धृतम् was taken out.

40021135.author: Translation
40021135.content: Therefore, I created one woman for the sake of distinction among them, extracting whatever was excellent from each limb of the creatures.

40021136.author: पदार्थः
40021136.content: ततः then, मया by me, रूपगुणैः with qualities of beauty, अहल्या Ahalya, स्त्री a woman, विनिर्मिता was created, हलं Hala, नाम indeed, इह here, वैरूपं ugliness, हल्यं that which is born from Hala, तत्प्रभवं born from that, भवेत् is.

40021136.author: Translation
40021136.content: Then, I created a woman named Ahalya, endowed with qualities of beauty, for "Hala" here means ugliness or deformity, and "Halya" is that which arises from it.

40021137.author: पदार्थः
40021137.content: यस्मात् because, न not, विद्यते exists, हल्यं ugliness, तेन therefore, अहल्येति as Ahalya, विश्रुता renowned, अहल्येति as Ahalya, मया by me, शक्र O Shakra, तस्याः her, नाम name, प्रवर्तितम् was given.

40021137.author: Translation
40021137.content: Because no ugliness exists in her, she is renowned as Ahalya, and O Shakra, I thus established her name as Ahalya.

40021138.author: पदार्थः
40021138.content: निर्मितायां when created, च and, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, तस्यां in that, नार्यां woman, सुरर्षभ O best of gods, भविष्यतीति will be, कस्यैषा whose is this, मम my, चिन्ता worry, ततो then, अभवत् arose,

40021138.author: Translation
40021138.content: O Indra, O best of gods, when that woman was created, a worry arose in me, thinking, "Whose will she be?"

40021139.author: पदार्थः
40021139.content: त्वं you, तु indeed, शक्र O Shakra, तदा then, नारीं woman, जानीषे knew, मनसा mentally, प्रभो O lord, स्थानाधिकतया due to superiority of position, पत्नी wife, ममैषेति mine is this, पुरन्दर O Purandara,

40021139.author: Translation
40021139.content: O Shakra, O Lord, O Purandara, you then mentally considered that woman to be your wife due to your superior position.

40021140.author: पदार्थः
40021140.content: सा she, मया by me, न्यासभूता as a deposit, तु but, गौतमस्य of Gautama, महात्मनः the great-souled, न्यस्ता entrusted, बहूनि many, वर्षाणि years, तेन by him, निर्यातिता returned, च and, ह indeed,

40021140.author: Translation
40021140.content: But she was entrusted by me as a deposit to the great-souled Gautama for many years, and indeed, she was returned by him.

40021141.author: पदार्थः
40021141.content: ततस्तस्य then his, परिज्ञाय having known, महास्थैर्यं great steadfastness, महामुनेः of the great sage, ज्ञात्वा having known, तपसि in penance, सिद्धिं success, च and, पत्न्यर्थं for the purpose of a wife, स्पर्शिता offered, तदा then,

40021141.author: Translation
40021141.content: Then, having understood the great steadfastness of that great sage and his success in penance, she was offered to him as a wife.

40021142.author: पदार्थः
40021142.content: सङ्क्रुद्धस्त्वं you, being very angry, हि indeed, धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, गत्वा having gone, तस्याश्रमं to his hermitage, मुनेः of the sage, दृष्टवांश्च and you saw, तदा then, तां that, स्त्रीं woman, दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव shining like a flame of fire,

40021142.author: Translation
40021142.content: Indeed, you, being very angry, O righteous one, went to that sage's hermitage and then saw that woman shining like a flame of fire.

40021143.author: पदार्थः
40021143.content: सा She, त्वया by you, धर्षिता was violated, शक्र O Shakra, कामार्तेन afflicted by lust, समन्युना with anger, दृष्टः seen, त्वं you, च and, तदा then, तेन by him, हि indeed, आश्रमे in the hermitage, परमर्षिणा by the great sage.

40021143.author: Translation
40021143.content: O Shakra, she was violated by you, who were afflicted by lust and anger, and you were then indeed seen in the hermitage by the great sage.

40021144.author: पदार्थः
40021144.content: ततः Then, क्रुद्धेन by the enraged, तेन by him, असि you were, शप्तः cursed, परमतेजसा of great ascetic power, गतः gone, असि you are, येन by which, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, दशाभागविपर्ययम् a reversal of your state.

40021144.author: Translation
40021144.content: Then, by that enraged sage of great ascetic power, you were cursed, O king of gods, by which you have undergone a reversal of your state.

40021145.author: पदार्थः
40021145.content: यस्मात् Because, मे my, धर्षिता was violated, पत्नी wife, त्वया by you, वासव O Vasava, निर्भयम् fearlessly, तस्मात् therefore, त्वं you, समरे in battle, राजन् O king, शत्रुहस्तं into the hands of enemies, गमिष्यसि will go.

40021145.author: Translation
40021145.content: Because my wife was fearlessly violated by you, O Vasava, therefore, O king, you will fall into the hands of your enemies in battle.

40021146.author: पदार्थः
40021146.content: अयं This, तु but, भावः state/consequence, दुर्बुद्धे O evil-minded one, यः which, त्वया by you, इह here, प्रवर्तितः initiated, मानुषेषु among humans, अपि even, लोकेषु in worlds, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt.

40021146.author: Translation
40021146.content: But this consequence, O evil-minded one, which you have initiated here, will undoubtedly also manifest in the human worlds.

40021147.author: पदार्थः
40021147.content: तत्र There, अर्धं half, तस्य of that, यः who, कर्ता doer, त्वयि on you, अर्धं half, निपतिष्यति will fall, न not, च and, ते for you, स्थावरं fixed, स्थानं place, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt.

40021147.author: Translation
40021147.content: In that matter, half of the consequence will fall upon the doer, and half upon you, and undoubtedly, you will not have a fixed abode.

40021148.author: पदार्थः
40021148.content: यश्च यश्च whoever, whoever, सुरेन्द्रः king of gods, स्यात् may be, ध्रुवः permanent, स he, न not, भविष्यति will be, एषः this, शापः curse, मया by me, मुक्तः uttered, इति thus, असौ he, त्वाम् to you, तदा then, अब्रवीत् said.

40021148.author: Translation
40021148.content: The sage then told you that whoever becomes the king of gods will not remain permanent, as this curse has been uttered by him.

40021149.author: पदार्थः
40021149.content: ताम् her, तु indeed, भार्याम् wife, सः he, निर्भर्त्स्य having rebuked, सः he, अब्रवीत् said, सुमहातपाः the great ascetic, दुर्विनीते O ill-behaved one, विनिध्वंस perish, मम my, आश्रमसमीपतः from the vicinity of the hermitage.

40021149.author: Translation
40021149.content: Having rebuked his wife, the great ascetic then said, "O ill-behaved one, disappear from the vicinity of my hermitage!"

40021150.author: पदार्थः
40021150.content: रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना endowed with beauty and youth, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, अनवस्थिता are unstable, तस्मात् therefore, रूपवती beautiful woman, लोके in the world, न not, त्वम् you, एका alone, भविष्यति will be.

40021150.author: Translation
40021150.content: Because you, endowed with beauty and youth, are unstable, therefore you will not be the only beautiful woman in the world.

40021151.author: पदार्थः
40021151.content: रूपम् beauty, च and, ते your, प्रजाः creatures, सर्वाः all, गमिष्यन्ति will obtain, न not, संशयः doubt, यत् which, तत् that, एकम् unique, समाश्रित्य having relied upon, विभ्रमः delusion, अयम् this, उपस्थितः has arisen.

40021151.author: Translation
40021151.content: All creatures will undoubtedly obtain your beauty, having relied upon which unique beauty this delusion has arisen.

40021152.author: पदार्थः
40021152.content: तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, भूयिष्ठम् mostly, प्रजाः creatures, रूपसमन्विताः endowed with beauty, सा she, तम् him, प्रसादयामास propitiated, महर्षिम् the great sage, गौतमम् Gautama, तदा then.

40021152.author: Translation
40021152.content: From that time onwards, most creatures became endowed with beauty, and then she (Ahalya) propitiated the great sage Gautama.

40021153.author: पदार्थः
40021153.content: अज्ञानात् due to ignorance, हर्षिता deceived, विप्र O Brahmana, त्वद्रूपेण in your guise, दिवौकसा by the celestial being (Indra), न not, कामकारात् willingly, विप्रर्षे O Brahmana-sage, प्रसादम् grace, कर्तुम् to grant, अर्हसि you ought.

40021153.author: Translation
40021153.content: O Brahmana-sage, I was deceived by the celestial being in your guise due to ignorance, not willingly, so you ought to grant me your grace.

40021154.author: पदार्थः
40021154.content: अहल्यया by Ahalya, तु indeed, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, प्रत्युवाच replied, सः he, गौतमः Gautama, उत्पत्स्यति will be born, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, महारथः a great warrior.

40021154.author: Translation
40021154.content: Thus addressed by Ahalya, Gautama replied that a greatly effulgent and great warrior of the Ikshvaku dynasty would be born.

40021155.author: पदार्थः
40021155.content: रामः Rama, नाम by name, श्रुतः known, लोके in the world, वनम् forest, च and, अपि also, उपयास्यति will come, ब्राह्मणार्थे for the sake of Brahmanas, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, विष्णुः Vishnu, मानुषविग्रहः in human form, तम् him, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see, यदा when, भद्रे O auspicious one, ततः then, पूता purified, भविष्यसि you will become.

40021155.author: Translation
40021155.content: He will be known as Rama in the world, will come to the forest for the sake of Brahmanas, being the mighty-armed Vishnu in human form; when you see him, O auspicious one, you will then become purified.

40021156.author: पदार्थः
40021156.content: सः he, हि indeed, पावयितुम् to purify, शक्तः capable, त्वया by you, यत् whatever, दुष्कृतम् evil deed, कृतम् done, तस्य his, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, च and, कृत्वा having done, वै indeed, मत्समीपम् to my proximity, गमिष्यसि you will go.

40021156.author: Translation
40021156.content: He is indeed capable of purifying whatever evil deed you have committed, and after offering him hospitality, you will return to my side.

40021157.author: पदार्थः
40021157.content: वत्स्यसि you will dwell, त्वम् you, मया with me, सार्धम् together, तदा then, हि indeed, वरवर्णिनि O beautiful lady, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सः he, विप्रर्षिः the Brahmana-sage, आजगाम went, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage.

40021157.author: Translation
40021157.content: Then, O beautiful lady, you will indeed dwell with me; having spoken thus, the Brahmana-sage returned to his own hermitage.

40021158.author: पदार्थः
40021158.content: तपः penance, च and, आचार performed, सुमहत् very great, सा she, पत्नी wife, ब्रह्मवादिनः of the knower of Brahman, शापोत्सर्गात् from the utterance of the curse, हि indeed, तस्य of that, इदम् this, मुनेः of the sage, सर्वम् all, उपस्थितम् has come to pass.

40021158.author: Translation
40021158.content: Indeed, that wife of the knower of Brahman performed very great penance, and all this has come to pass from the utterance of the sage's curse.

40021159.author: पदार्थः
40021159.content: तत् that, स्मर remember, त्वम् you, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, दुष्कृतम् evil deed, यत् which, त्वया by you, कृतम् was done, तेन by that, त्वम् you, ग्रहणम् capture, शत्रोः by the enemy, यातः have obtained, न not, अन्येन by another, वासव O Vasava.

40021159.author: Translation
40021159.content: O mighty-armed Vasava, remember that evil deed which you committed; by that alone have you been captured by the enemy, and not by any other means.

40021160.author: पदार्थः
40021160.content: शीघ्रम् quickly, वै indeed, यज perform, यज्ञम् sacrifice, त्वम् you, वैष्णवम् related to Vishnu, सुसमाहितः with great concentration, पावितः purified, तेन by that, यज्ञेन by the sacrifice, यास्यसे you will go, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, ततः thereafter.

40021160.author: Translation
40021160.content: You must quickly perform a Vaishnava sacrifice with great concentration, and purified by that sacrifice, you will then ascend to heaven.

40021161.author: पदार्थः
40021161.content: पुत्रः son, च and, तव your, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, न not, विनष्टः perished, महारणे in the great battle, नीतः taken, सन्निहितः kept, च and, एव indeed, आर्यकेण by Aryaka, महोदधौ in the great ocean.

40021161.author: Translation
40021161.content: O king of gods, your son did not perish in the great battle; he was taken and kept safe by Aryaka in the great ocean.

40021162.author: पदार्थः
40021162.content: एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, तु and, यज्ञम् sacrifice, इष्ट्वा having performed, च and, वैष्णवम् related to Vishnu, पुनः again, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, आक्रामत् ascended, अन्वशासत् ruled, च and, देवराट् the king of gods.

40021162.author: Translation
40021162.content: Having heard this, Mahendra performed the Vaishnava sacrifice, and the king of gods then ascended to heaven again and ruled.

40021163.author: पदार्थः
40021163.content: एतत् this, इन्द्रजितः of Indrajit, नाम indeed, बलं strength, यत् which, कीर्तितम् has been recounted, मया by me, निर्जितः conquered, तेन by him, देवेन्द्रः the lord of gods, प्राणिनः living beings, अन्ये others, तु but, किं what, पुनः moreover.

40021163.author: Translation
40021163.content: This is the power of Indrajit that I have recounted, by which even the lord of gods, Indra, was conquered; what then to speak of other living beings?

40021164.author: पदार्थः
40021164.content: आश्चर्यम् wonderful, इति thus, रामः Rama, च and, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, च and, अब्रवीत् said, तदा then, अगस्त्यवचनम् the words of Agastya, श्रुत्वा having heard, वानराः monkeys, राक्षसाः demons, तदा then.

40021164.author: Translation
40021164.content: Then, having heard the words of Agastya, Rama and Lakshmana, along with the monkeys and demons, exclaimed, "Wonderful!"

40021165.author: पदार्थः
40021165.content: विभीषणः Vibhishana, तु but, रामस्य of Rama, पार्श्वस्थः standing by the side, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, आश्चर्यम् a wonder, स्मारितः reminded, अस्मि I am, अद्य today, यत् which, तत् that, दृष्टम् seen, पुरातनम् ancient.

40021165.author: Translation
40021165.content: But Vibhishana, standing by Rama's side, spoke, saying, "I am reminded today of that ancient wonder which I had seen."

40021166.author: पदार्थः
40021166.content: अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, तु but, अब्रवीत् said, रामः Rama, सत्यम् true, एतत् this, श्रुतम् heard, च and, मे by me.

40021166.author: Translation
40021166.content: But Rama said to Agastya, "This is true, and I have also heard it."

40021167.author: पदार्थः
40021167.content: एवम् thus, राम O Rama, समुद्भूतः originated, रावणः Ravana, लोककण्टकः a tormentor of the world, सपुत्रः with his son, येन by whom, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, जितः conquered, शक्रः Shakra, सुरेश्वरः the lord of gods.

40021167.author: Translation
40021167.content: O Rama, thus was born Ravana, a tormentor of the world, by whom, along with his son, Shakra, the lord of gods, was conquered in battle. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 30 ।। Thus ends the thirtieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
